notes: The phone comparison preserves the 36-tile ring, five landmark positions, central anchor, and portrait framing without route occlusion.
Hatchery, Portal, Palace, Sanctuary, and Archive now read as distinct authored roles; the Palace and Archive remain smoother than the painted target.
Large ribs, domes, cornices, windows, buttresses, and interior forms improved, but the target still contains materially denser layered arches, recesses, balconies, and trim.
The 360 reef and crag root are coherent and phone-readable, but coral still reads more as perimeter gardens than architecture-grown terraces.
Animated fish, hero fish, manta, whale, jellyfish, bubbles, submarine, motes, surface, and light shafts provide a convincing living underwater volume.
Turquoise bodies, pearl roofs, gold trim, amber apertures, portal glow, and subtle shared relief are stronger, but the goal remains richer and more jewel-like.
